description: R08 host TextBufferIterator cluster: safe Rust cell/text views share one bounded row-major iterator owner and close all 29 Microsoft contracts in one material CI checkpoint.

entries.notes: Safe Rust text-buffer iterator ownership reproduces the Microsoft row-major cursor, bounds, comparison, movement, dereference and stored-cell observables exercised by this contract.
